About 7.4 million people were waiting in August — up 41,848 in a month, and the FOURTH rise in five months. Even the Health Foundation is asking whether the government's headline pledge should be swapped for something 'more realistic'.

Patients don't care about targets. They care when they'll be seen. 💙
